question: I’d always read bowel hunting as ‘chougari’ but I learned it’s read as ‘harawatagari’ when I read the novels; what part of the internal organs is Elsa’s favorite?
answer: It’s probably ‘Most organs!’, but I think it would be the long, floppy parts of the small or large intestine. The part that pops out from internal pressure when you cut the belly open. (Note: The question is referring to two different ways to read Elsa’s ‘bowel hunter’ title, ‘腸狩り’.)
